about: Patch releases for the 3DS game とんがりボウシと魔法の町 (Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Machi). Same shape as patches.json: newest release first. Each download is a link to the patch file (host it in the public bucket under patches/3ds/, or any public URL) plus optional checksums.
statusNote: An English patch for the 3DS game is in progress. Downloads, release notes and checksums will appear here when the first version ships.
